acceptanceCriteria: A citation whose anchor text moved uniquely is reported with its new line and a one-command repin, or accepted as relocated per the citation spec; missing or ambiguous text still fails.
Tests cover moved-unique, moved-ambiguous, and changed-text cases; the citation anchor spec is updated.
body: Friction from V1-1528 (PR #998): adding tests to internal/companionrelease/companionrelease_test.go shifted two cited functions (620->692, 390->462); docs/specs/stable-operations-v0.md citations then failed line-citations-check although their anchor hashes were unchanged, forcing a separate repin commit and bind. Expected: when the cited line moved but its hash-matching text is uniquely found, the check reports the new line (or a repin hint/auto-fix command) instead of a hard failure, keeping refusal when the text is missing or ambiguous.
title: line-citations-check: re-locate a path:line@hash citation whose anchor hash still matches after lines shift
